lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular spots are arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gills, with approximately 5-6 horizontal rows and over 10 vertical columns visible on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like structure of intersection nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across its surface, with a higher concentration observed near the leading edge and lower base.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit displays a significantly higher density of smaller, less organized high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank grid.
